Rashi on Nedarim 51a:10:1.hebrew: ממעשה רתחתא - היינו דבר שנגמר בישולו בקדרה, ואינו אלא מחמשת המינין, לאפוקי דבר שאין גמר בישולו בקדירה עד שמבשלין אותו באילפס:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:10:1.english: From [food] made by boiling - That is, something whose cooking is completed in a pot, and it is only [made] from the five species [of grain] — to exclude something whose cooking is not completed in a pot until it is cooked in a stewpot.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:10:2.english: In anything prepared in a pot - Even [food] cooked in a stewpot is prohibited.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:1.hebrew: ביורד באילפס שכבר כו' - הואיל וקודם שמניחו באילפס מבשלו בקדרה, והדר מניחו באילפס — כן היה מנהגן — והוי יורד לקדרה, ולפיכך אסור:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:1.english: In that which enters into a stewpot, for [it has] already, etc. - Since before he places it in a stewpot, he cooks it in a pot, and then places it in the stewpot — such was their custom — it is [considered] "that which enters into a pot," and therefore it is forbidden.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:2.english: [One who vows] from that which goes into a stewpot is permitted [to benefit] from those that go into a pot - [that is, while it is still in the pot] before it goes into the stewpot.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:3.hebrew: מן הנעשה בקדירה - לגמרי כל בישולו, שאינו יורד לאילפס כלל:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:3.english: From that which is cooked in a dish - [meaning] completely, all of its cooking, such that it does not enter into a stewpot at all.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:4.hebrew: מותר בנעשה באילפס - אע"פ שהיה קודם לכן בקדרה:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:4.english: [He is] permitted [to eat] that which is prepared in a stewpot - Even though it was previously in a pot.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:11:5.english: [He is] permitted [to partake of] that which is prepared in a pot - [meaning,] that which is finished [cooking] in a pot.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:1:1.english: That with any griva I wish - With whatever measure I wish, I will take.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:1:2.english: Smeared it with tar - He coated it with pitch on the outside so that it would hold the wheat.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:1:3.english: Let him measure for me - He shall measure for me.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:1:4.english: I am owed by you - That is to say, that you owe me.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:2:1.english: I will drink wine at your father's dancing - [Meaning] that your father will dance.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:2:2.hebrew: ובקירקני דאמך - במזיגתה, שאמך תמזוג לי הכוס:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:2:2.english: And with your mother's kirekanei - With her pouring, that your mother will pour the cup for me.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:3:1.english: What [is] to’eva - Both of them did [so — she poured and he danced].

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:3:2.hebrew: תרמי לי נטלא - תמזוג לי הכוס, כמו אנטל:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:3:2.english: [Let her] pour me a natla - [She will] pour me the cup, [natla being] like antal.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:3:3.english: You are straying after it - That is to say, he leaves his permitted wife and takes hold of this [one] of licentiousness.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:4:1.english: [What is tevel - as it is written:] "Neither shall a woman stand before a beast to lie with it; it is perversion [tevel]" (Leviticus 18).

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:4:2.hebrew: כי עניינא קמא - תיתי דביתכי תירמי לי, ולדידיה א"ל: קום רקוד לי:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:4:2.english: As in the first matter - [Bar Kappara said to Rabbi:] "Let your wife come and pour [wine] for me," and to him [Rabbi] he said: "Arise and dance for me."

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:4:3.hebrew: וכי תבלין יש בה - כלומר, יש בביאה זו טעם מבאחרות, שמנחת בעלה ונרבעת לבהמה:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:4:3.english: Does it have spice? - That is to say, [does] this act of intercourse have [more] flavor than others, that she leaves her husband and lies with a beast?

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:5:1.hebrew: זו מאי היא - ומפרש ביבמות (דף לז:) באיש הבא על נשים הרבה, וכן אשה שנבעלה לאנשים הרבה ואינה יודעת מאיזה מהם נתעברה והולידה בת — נמצא אב נושא את בתו ואח נושא את אחותו. על זה נאמר "ומלאה הארץ זימה", כלומר: זו מה היא? שאין אדם יודע אותה אשה שהוא נושא, אם מותרת לו אם לאו:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:5:1.english: What is she [zo mai hi] - And [the Gemara] explains in Yevamot (37b) [that this refers to] a man who engages in intercourse with many women, and likewise a woman who had intercourse with many men and does not know from which of them she conceived and gave birth to a daughter — it turns out that a father marries his daughter and a brother marries his sister. Regarding this it is stated, "And the land will be filled with lewdness [zimah]," meaning: "What is she?" — for a man does not know [regarding] that woman whom he is marrying whether she is permitted to him or not.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:5:2.hebrew: לא יכיל בן אלעשה למיסבל - אותו זילותא של רבי, לפי שהיה עשיר גדול ולא היה יכול לראות דבר של זילותא מחמיו:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:5:2.english: Ben Elasa could not tolerate - that humiliation of Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], because he was very wealthy and could not bear to see any matter of humiliation [done] to his father-in-law.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:6:1.hebrew: מאי בן אלעשה - כלומר, מנין דהוה עשיר:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:6:1.english: What [is] ben Elasa - That is to say, from where [do we know] that he was wealthy?

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:6:2.hebrew: פיזר מעותיו - שהיה נותן ממון גדול לספר שהיה מספר לו כתגלחת של כ"ג:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:6:2.english: He dispensed his money - For he would give a large sum of money to a barber who would cut his hair like the haircut of a High Priest.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:7:1.english: A unique haircut - That there is none like it.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:8:1.english: [The] remutza [gourd] — kara karkuzai - [These are] gourds of that place, which never cook well.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:8:2.hebrew: הטמונה ברמץ - עפר של גחלים, דלאו תבשיל הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:8:2.english: That is buried in embers [remetz] - [Remetz is] the ash of coals, for it is not [considered] a cooked dish.

Rashi on Nedarim 51a:9:1.hebrew: כלאים עם דלעת הרמוצה - אלמא דהרמוצה לאו טמונה ברמץ, אלא שם מקום הוא ומין זרעים הוא:
Rashi on Nedarim 51a:9:1.english: Diverse kinds with the remutza gourd - Thus, remutza is not [a gourd] buried in hot embers; rather, it is the name of a place, and it is a species of seeds.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:10:1.hebrew: הנודר ממעשה קדירה אינו אסור אלא במעשה רתחתא - דבר שנגמרה בקדירה, ואין אסור [אלא] בדבר שנגמר בו. ובקונם היורד לקדירה, אפילו באילפס — אסור בכל המתבשל בקדירה, ואפילו גמרו באילפס:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:10:1.english: One who vows [not to eat] food cooked in a pot is prohibited only from food cooked by boiling - [This refers to] something whose [cooking] is completed in a pot, and he is prohibited [only] from something that is completed in it. [And regarding "konam that which enters into a pot," even if it is] in a stewpot — he is prohibited from anything that is cooked in a pot, even if he finished [cooking] it in a stewpot.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:1.hebrew: תנא הנודר מן היורד בקדירה אסור ביורד לאילפס - אחר שירד לקדירה, דיורד לקדירה משמע שירד תחלה לקדירה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:1.english: It was taught: One who vows [not to benefit] from that which goes into a pot is forbidden from that which goes into a stewpot - [meaning,] after it has gone into a pot, for "that which goes into a pot" implies [even] that which went into a pot first [before entering the stewpot].

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:2.hebrew: מן היורד [לאילפס] מותר ביורד לקדירה - תחילה, אע"פ שנגמר באילפס; דיורד לעולם משמע על שם תחלת ירידתו ולא על שמ סופו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:2.english: "[One who vows] from that which goes down [into a stewpot] is permitted in that which goes down into a pot" - [That is, what goes down into it] first, even though it is finished in a stewpot; for "that which goes down" always implies [being named] after the beginning of its going down, and not after its end.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:3.hebrew: מן הנעשה בקדירה - משמע הנגמר, הלכך מותר היורד לקדירה תחלה ונגמר באילפס:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:11:3.english: "From that which is prepared in a pot" - [This] implies that which is finished [in it]; therefore, [food] that goes into a pot first and is finished in a stewpot is permitted.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:12:1.english: "[One who vows] from that which goes down into an oven is prohibited only from bread" - For nothing is called "that which goes down into an oven" except bread alone.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:12:2.hebrew: כל מעשה תנור עלי אסור בכל הנעשה בתנור - צ"ע, דמשמע דהחילוק בין "יורד" ל"מעשה"; ואמאי תנא "כל מעשה"? א"כ, ברישא ליתני "כל יורד":
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:12:2.english: "Anything made in an oven is [forbidden] to me — he is prohibited from anything made in an oven" - This requires further study, as it implies that the distinction is between "that which enters" [yored] and "that which is made" [ma'aseh]; then why did [the Tanna] teach "anything made"? If so, in the first clause he should have taught "anything that enters".

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:1:1.english: He smeared it with tar - He smeared it with tar.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:1:3.hebrew: דרשינא בך - שהלויתיך, ומילי דבדיחותא היה אומר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:1:3.english: That I am owed by you - [Meaning,] that I lent you, and he was speaking words of jest.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:2:1.hebrew: ברקודא דאבוך ובקורקני דאימך - כמו מרקדים, טרפיי"ד:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:2:1.english: At your father's dancing and your mother's korkanei - Like dancing, [in Old French:] trepier [to dance/stamp].

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:3:1.english: You are straying after it - [Meaning] that they leave their wives and go to [engage in] homosexual intercourse.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:4:1.hebrew: תבלין יש - בביאה זו, משניא הדא ביאה מכל ביאות:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:4:1.english: "Is there spice" - [that is,] in this act of intercourse? Is this act of intercourse different from all [other] acts of intercourse?

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:8:1.hebrew: קרי קרקוזאי - דילועין של אותו מקום, שאינו בכלל תבשיל:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:8:1.english: Karei karkuzai - Gourds of that place, which are not included in [the category of] cooked food.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:8:2.english: A gourd buried in embers - it is not in the category of a cooked dish.

Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:9:1.hebrew: כלאים - מכלל דהרמוצה לא הוי טמונה ברמץ, אלא על שם מקום הוא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 51a:9:1.english: Diverse kinds - This implies that the remutza [gourd] is not [one] buried in hot ashes [remetz]; rather, it is [named] after a place.
